My sister lets the power go to her head and while she can generally make my little brother obey her she has a tougher time with me. I just dropped it cause its not worth arguing any point with my mom. AITA here? EDIT:My brother told me afterwards that he was the one that told mom, I forgave him cause I mean I can't be mad at that little turd for too long
